Entry Reeds and Catch of the Neck The Neck's water network was not good at producing luxury goods, but it supported a people who relied on fish, reeds, peat and hidden channels. The foreign troops only saw swamps blocking the road, but the residents under Li Duc's rule knew that every shallow ditch could hide boats, food, and things they didn't want to be seen.
